data.name: Dhariyat
data.gender_notes: Dhariyat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Quran, Dhariyat is the name of a sea that God created to separate two parts of the earth. The name means 'the drifting', indicating the continuous motion of the sea. The name Dhariyat carries the meaning “The Drifting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dhariyat usually hope their child will grow to embody the drifting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the ever-flowing nature of life and the faith that guides us through its waves.
data.etymology: Dhariyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Drifting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhariyat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
